import copy
def make_rectangular_frame(grid, r1, c1, r2, c2):
    """Create rectangle from two opposite corners (r1,c1) and (r2,c2)"""
    result = copy.deepcopy(grid)
    # Top edge
    for c in range(min(c1, c2), max(c1, c2) + 1):
        result[r1][c] = 3
    # Bottom edge
    for c in range(min(c1, c2), max(c1, c2) + 1):
        result[r2][c] = 3
    # Left edge
    for r in range(min(r1, r2), max(r1, r2) + 1):
        result[r][min(c1, c2)] = 3
    # Right edge
    for r in range(min(r1, r2), max(r1, r2) + 1):
        result[r][max(c1, c2)] = 3
    return result
